rust_summary: a pickup click before item stack overrides (`native_item_stacked_on_other`).
doc_summary: A pickup click calls `native_item_stacked_on_other` before item overrides, on both sides. Mods can change the carried and clicked stacks. Canceling skips the overrides; `cancellation_result` decides whether the rest of the click is also skipped. Bundles that use it need `"hooks": @API:native_item_stacked_on_other@`.
